dialogues.value: Great, you've made it inside the mines 305. Its the same as before. Navigate the area carefully and see what you can find and careful.
We are monitoring your progress and we haven't been able to get a signal, down there but your credits should still update.
Keep us posted on anything you find.
Alright, 305. We have sent the vendor ahead. Meet up with him and pick up any of the beacons that are still available.
We can't reach further with our systems. Can you ... th.. ignal's cutting out.
Well so much for an easy job.
Oh hey, 305! It's me again! The little bin man. You remember the deal from last time.
You're going to need a mask if you want to continue, so you've got to pay the toll fee, yet again!
You can buy one for another 200 credits. I sure do hope you've got enough.
What's with this system? At this point I might lose more than I make.
Well blame the captain for it!
